verifications.notes: The query concatenates the raw $id parameter directly into the SQL string with no casting, escaping, or parameter binding. No ownership or role check is present in this method.
Dynamic SQL is built by concatenating @Customer and @Sort directly into the statement with no validation or allow‑list. The procedure executes the constructed string immediately.
The EXEC(@sql) call runs the user‑supplied dynamic SQL without any sanitization or parameterization.
The included auth.asp only verifies that a session exists; it does not enforce any role. The delete statement is executed for any authenticated user.

The controller class is marked with [Authorize], which requires authentication but not an admin role. The DeleteUser action lacks a role check, allowing any authenticated user to delete arbitrary accounts.
